text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun safely finishes her Debut 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having yearned for the Twinkle Series for 
so long, she couldn't help feeling that 
the race she ran was far more boring than 
she had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was bewildered by the gap between 
expectation and reality. However, she was 
still only at the debut stage. Perhaps 
running in more races might bring a change 
of heart...
